primary_endpoint: Sum of five original offline native Cargo compilation commands per block

order: Existing counterbalanced three-variant rotation by VM and round, reversing alternate rounds

scope: No added ThinLTO; recipe comparison also changes native compiler-build linking tools; not isolated profile quality
